853:t_113:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Situation understood. This unit makes the same judgment as AG.」

853:t_113:15.en:
$$レド$$
「I see... I'll give it a try too, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

853:t_114:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Miss $$ラケージ$$!」

853:t_114:4.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Not a bad feeling, this.」

853:t_114:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If it pleases Miss $$ラケージ$$, then I, AG, will work myself to the bone in your service.」

853:t_114:6.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Then I shall make a request. Would you mind?」

853:t_114:8.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Turn around and proceed at full speed. You needn't come back until I say you may.」

853:t_114:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「B-but then... the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ would be left unmanned...」

853:t_114:10.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Pirates take what they want. Surely you knew that?」

853:t_114:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even I, when I weigh the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ against my own desires, have no choice but to exercise restraint...」

853:t_115:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's wrong, Miss $$セツコ$$? You're holding your body so stiff...」

853:t_115:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm glad of the congratulations, but why do you need to whisper them in my ear on purpose?」

853:t_115:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. It's not something I decided on my own.」

853:t_115:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then I'll carry out the $$グローリー・スター$$ way of doing things, as custom dictates.」

853:t_115:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You who shoulder the $$グローリー・スター$$, bearer of the right qualities! You must always live with pride!」

853:t_115:17.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you have time to chase after a lady's b-b-butt, accomplish the goals you set yourself at 120% power! That is the mission of the $$グローリー・スター$$!」

853:t_115:19.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Thank you, Chief, $$トビー$$... I was able to do it too.)

853:t_115:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Thank you very much, Mr. $$デンゼル$$, Mr. $$トビー$$... I got to enjoy a different side of Miss $$セツコ$$.)

853:t_116:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「To thank you, I'll do your maintenance for you.」

853:t_116:7.en:
$$メール$$
「Don't hold back! Leave it to Darling and breaking 120% output is no dream!」

853:t_116:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-wait, you say that, but with that 120% output on your end, aren't you planning to The Crusher my lovable body...」

853:t_116:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「Oh, you do! I'll even give you a wax job!」

853:t_116:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(What pushiness... Truly worthy of $$ザ・ヒート$$...)

853:t_116:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(For some reason I seem to be weak against Darling...)

853:t_117:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks. I bet it's just the thought, though.」

853:t_117:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The world is a harsh place, isn't it...」

853:t_117:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's the old 'if you feel sorry for me, give me some... you know what' deal. I curse the world for making me like this.」

853:t_117:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'd say it's a matter of your nature more than your environment. Blaming others is unseemly.」

853:t_117:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But don't worry. Once you become an ace pilot, the amount of funds you earn should go up.」

853:t_117:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「On top of that, in Mr. $$クロウ$$'s case, the funds you earn should go up for your personal skills as well.」

853:t_117:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Hearing that gets me fired up! I'll keep shooting 'em down hard from now on!」

853:t_117:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Though the funds earned belong to the whole unit, not the individual, of course...)

853:t_117:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Do your best, Mr. $$クロウ$$. For the sake of $c's coffers.)

853:t_118:4.en:
$n
「Thanks, AG. This is partly thanks to you, too.」

853:t_118:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That smile is really becoming natural on you. Isn't it about time you stopped being the quiet type?」

853:t_118:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's because you can't just laugh it off in moments like that that people call you the quiet type.」

853:t_118:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And if you could come back with a gag, too, you'd be perfect!」

853:t_118:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let me think... ...If someone asked how your stopping being the quiet type is going...」

853:t_118:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Perfectly, Powerfully, Plumply OK! ...How about a comeback like that?」

853:t_118:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And strike a pose, too! A wide stance for Perfectly, flexed muscles for Powerfully, and for Plumply, the chinpyorosupon~!」

853:t_118:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now... join me! Perfectly, Powerfully, Plumply OK!」

853:t_118:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You've still got a long way to go, $n. Anyone who can't let go of themselves won't grasp anything from here on.」

853:t_118:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That's right... For the time will come when you must abandon everything.)

853:t_119:4.en:
$n
「Thanks, AG. This is partly thanks to you, too.」

853:t_119:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That smile is really becoming natural on you. Isn't it about time you stopped being the quiet type?」

853:t_119:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$

853:t_119:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And if you could come back with a gag, too, you'd be perfect!」

853:t_119:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let me think... ...If someone asked how your stopping being the quiet type is going...」
